title: Sky Drifters Hot Air Ballooning

services.name: Balloon Lift-Off
services.desc: There are hot air balloon festivals all over the world and each one is a little different. Some are big with many balloons, and some are smaller with just a few balloons. Either way, watching balloons flying through the air is a beautiful sight. Hot air balloons can fly two times per day depending upon the location

services.name: private charter flight
services.desc: Looking for prices for a hot air balloon ride for 2 to 6 of your favorite friends or family? There is nothing quite like the serene feeling of being one with the breeze and flying high above the landscape in a hot air balloon. Except for when you get to share the experience with the important people in your life. In Northern California, Sky Drifters Hot Air Ballooning offers private hot air balloon rides for 2 to 6 people just outside of Sacramento and just a short ride from Napa Valley. A private hot air balloon ride is perfect for a group of friends, family, customers or a romantic trip for two. When you charter a private hot air balloon ride, only you and your guests are in the basket

services.name: 5. Skydive Yosemite
services.desc: Thrill seekers come one come all for the chance of a lifetime! Skydive Yosemite will take you to all new heights where you’ll see the El Capitan, Half Dome and Yosemite Valley from 10,000 feet (or more). When the time is right, you’ll jump out of the plane and free fall with views of the mountains, landing very close

services.name: Trail ride
services.desc: Yosemite Trails Horseback Adventures offers horseback trail rides for one or two hours. They’re an excellent opportunity for the family to engage with nature and ride a magnificent animal. You can also take the 5-hour round-trip ride to a 2,000-year-old redwood tree known as Grizzly Giant. Each horse is well-trained
